name: Redshift Environment Object
definition: Used for homogeneous volumes (uniform media such as atmospheric haze and fog) which do not need voxel data. It fills the scene, or a height limited layer of it, with a scattering medium. Also used for volumetric lighting (god rays).
summary: The Redshift Environment Object is a procedural volume primitive that fills scenes with homogeneous scattering media for atmospheric haze and god rays, eliminating the need for voxel data.
